name: std-agent-session
description: std-agent-session — the conversation with an in-app assistant. AgentThread owns the persisted AgentMessage rows (role, content, ownerId stamped with the real @user, createdAt): SEND stores the user's message, reloads the thread and emits CONVERSE with the whole conversation, oldest first, for std-agent-tool-loop to answer; REPLIED stores the reply. AgentConversation is what the user sees, in the browser: the thread as chat bubbles with every step the assistant takes interleaved live (STEP: each model call, each tool it used and what the app answered), a thinking row while it works, and a chat bar. Rows are meant to be private to their owner: owner-scoped access needs an [identity] roster, so the binding organism declares the @read/@create scoping on AgentMessage — this generic atom cannot.
